d.ko: DuneCrawl is an open world action-adventure game, where you take to the sandy seas atop a gigantic crustacean festooned with black powder cannons. Play as a solo Crab Keeper, or with a crew of up to three other friends in local and online coop.
d.en: DuneCrawl is an open world action-adventure game, where you take to the sandy seas atop a gigantic crustacean festooned with black powder cannons. Play as a solo Crab Keeper, or with a crew of up to three other friends in local and online coop.
d.zh: DuneCrawl 是一款在线合作的动作冒险游戏，玩家将扮演沙漠私掠者的角色。玩家们将共同驾驶他们的沙丘爬行器，这是一种装饰有大炮和藏宝图的巨型行走甲壳类生物，探索尘海。
